questions.question: Before 4 years, the age of A was twice the age of B. After 6 years, the age of C will be twice the age of A. The current age of A is 10 years more than that of B. What is the current age of C?
questions.solution:
Given,

The current age of A is 10 years more than that of B.

A = B + 10

B = A - 10

Let the current age of A be x.

⇒ Current age of B = x - 10

Given,

Before 4 years, the age of A was twice the age of B.

A - 4 = 2 (B - 4)

x - 4 = 2(x - 10 - 4)

x - 4 = 2(x - 14)

x - 4 = 2x - 28

2x - x = 28 - 4

x = 24

So, the present age of A = 24

Given, 

After 6 years, the age of C will be twice the age of A.

Let the present age of C be C.

C + 6 = 2(A + 6)

C + 6 = 2 (24 + 6)

C + 6 = 2(30)

C + 6 = 60

C = 60 - 6

C = 54

So, the present age of C is 54.

Hence, the correct answer is **"54"**.

questions.question: Maheep starts walking from his office and walks 120 m towards south. Then he turns left and walks a certain distance A m. Then turns right and walks 80 m. Then he turns left and walks another certain distance B m. He there by reaches his home. If the shortest distance between his office and home is 290 m, then what is the sum of the distances A and B that Maheep covered/walked?
questions.solution:
According to the given information :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/df7794fd41ef757611c5c58811f2ab39260e6debe60bb0d89bad7e32f2229a6d.png] 

Shortest distance between office and home = OP = 290 m.

OQ = 120 + 80 = 200 m.

PQ = A + B.

In right angled ΔOPQ, by Pythagoras Theorem :

(OP)² = (OQ)² + (PQ)²

290² = 200² + (A + B)²

84100 = 40000 + (A + B)2

84100 - 40000 = (A + B)2

44100 = (A + B)2

(A + B) = √44100

**(A + B) = 210.** 

Hence, the correct answer is **"210 m".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Shyok, the Gilgit, and the Zaskar are major tributaries of the Indus River.**
 
• The Indus System is one of the l**argest river basins in the world.**
 
• It is also known as the **Sindhu** and is in the westernmost of the Himalayan rivers in India.
 
• It originates from a **glacier near Bokhar Chu i**n the Tibetan region at an altitude of 4,164 m in the Kailash Mountain range. 
 
• Tributaries of Indus River:-
 
 
• The Indus receives a number of Himalayan tributaries such as The Shyok, The Gilgit, The Zaskar etc.
 
• It **finally emerges out of the hills near Attock where it receives the Kabul River on its right bank.**
 
 
 
• **Shyok River:-**
 
 
• It rises in the Karakoram Range in the Indian-administered Jammu and Kashmir state.
 
• The Shyok, which flows generally northwestward, is fed by meltwater from numerous glaciers on its journey through the range.
 
• At times the Chong Kumdan Glacier dams the river, causing serious floods in nearby areas hence, the Shyok river is known as the river of death. 
 
 
 
• **Gilgit River:-**
 
 
• The river rises from a high alpine glacier in the area where the Hindu Kush, Karakoram Range, and western (Punjab) Himalayas meet. Descending through a deep valley, it flows north and then east and southeast to the town of Gilgit.
